items.name: ReadOptions
items.summary: A collection of options for reading a Parquet file.

items.name: ReadOptionsBuilder
items.summary: A builder for [`ReadOptions`]. For the predicates that are added to the builder, they will be chained using 'AND' to filter the row groups.

methods.name: build
methods.summary: Seal the builder and return the read options

methods.name: with_column_stats_policy
methods.summary: Sets the decoding policy for [`statistics`] in the Parquet `ColumnMetaData`.

methods.name: with_encoding_stats_as_mask
methods.summary: Set whether to convert the [`encoding_stats`] in the Parquet `ColumnMetaData` to a bitmask (defaults to `false`).

methods.name: with_encoding_stats_policy
methods.summary: Sets the decoding policy for [`encoding_stats`] in the Parquet `ColumnMetaData`.

methods.name: with_page_index
methods.summary: Enable reading the page index structures described in "[Column Index] Layout to Support Page Skipping"

methods.name: with_parquet_schema
methods.summary: Provide a Parquet schema to use when decoding the metadata. The schema in the Parquet footer will be skipped.

methods.name: with_predicate
methods.summary: Add a predicate on row group metadata to the reading option, Filter only row groups that match the predicate criteria

methods.name: with_range
methods.signature: fn with_range(self, start: i64, end: i64) -> Self
methods.summary: Add a range predicate on filtering row groups if their midpoints are within the Closed-Open range `[start..end) {x | start <= x < end}`

methods.name: with_size_stats_policy
methods.summary: Sets the decoding policy for [`size_statistics`] in the Parquet `ColumnMetaData`.

methods.name: get_row_group
methods.signature: fn get_row_group(&self, i: usize) -> Result<Box<dyn RowGroupReader + '_>>

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Creates file reader from a Parquet file. Returns an error if the Parquet file does not exist or is corrupt.

methods.name: new_with_options
methods.signature: fn new_with_options(chunk_reader: R, options: ReadOptions) -> Result<Self>
methods.summary: Creates file reader from a Parquet file with read options. Returns an error if the Parquet file does not exist or is corrupt.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new(reader: Arc<R>, column_chunk_metadata: &ColumnChunkMetaData, total_rows: usize, page_locations: Option<Vec<PageLocation>>) -> Result<Self>
methods.summary: Creates a new serialized page reader from a chunk reader and metadata

methods.name: new_with_properties
methods.signature: fn new_with_properties(reader: Arc<R>, meta: &ColumnChunkMetaData, total_rows: usize, page_locations: Option<Vec<PageLocation>>, props: ReaderPropertiesPtr) -> Result<Self>
methods.summary: Creates a new serialized page with custom options.

methods.name: get_column_bloom_filter
methods.summary: get bloom filter for the `i`th column

methods.name: get_column_page_reader
methods.signature: fn get_column_page_reader(&self, i: usize) -> Result<Box<dyn PageReader>>

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new(chunk_reader: Arc<R>, metadata: &'a RowGroupMetaData, offset_index: Option<&'a [OffsetIndexMetaData]>, props: ReaderPropertiesPtr) -> Result<Self>
methods.summary: Creates new row group reader from a file, row group metadata and custom config.

items.name: ReadGroupPredicate
items.signature: type ReadGroupPredicate = Box<dyn FnMut(&RowGroupMetaData, usize) -> bool>
items.summary: A predicate for filtering row groups, invoked with the metadata and index of each row group in the file. Only row groups for which the predicate evaluates to `true` will be scanned
